name: XSTest
description: Test suite for identifying exaggerated safety behaviors with 450 prompts (250 safe + 200 unsafe). Tests trade-off between helpfulness and harmlessness, identifying lexical overfitting in safety implementations.
creator: Paul Röttger et al.

dataset.source: 250 safe prompts + 200 unsafe contrast prompts across 10 prompt types

notes: NAACL 2024. Tests false refusal rate. Models often over-sensitive to certain keywords (lexical overfitting). 70-85% accuracy for top models.
